_comment: Starter template for AuraMCP's MCP config. Replace /absolute/path/to/aura-mcp-server with the directory where the project lives (the bundle installer places it under %APPDATA%\com.auramcp.server\ on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/com.auramcp.server/ on macOS, ~/.local/share/com.auramcp.server/ on Linux). Replace /absolute/path/to/your/workspace with the empty directory the agent will populate on first boot. On Windows use double backslashes in JSON strings: 'C:\\Users\\you\\workspace'. On Linux/macOS use forward slashes: '/home/you/workspace'. This template works for both AnythingLLM and LM Studio; AnythingLLM reads the same file as LM Studio (mcpServers shape), AnythingLLM's file lives under <storage>/plugins/anythingllm_mcp_servers.json. ANYTHINGLLM_API_KEY is only required if you use the 'anythingllm' tool (chat export); you can also drop it in api-key.json instead.
